description: Desktop productivity app for screen capture, dictation, smart paste, time tracking, client work, and meetings.
notes: Requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime; KeptInFlow prompts to install it when it is missing.
Clipboard history is enabled by default. Screen Memory also turns on after first-run setup; its data stays on this PC unless you send or share it.

The optional phone-at-sign-in feature uses the KeptInFlow Lock Helper service and an inbound UDP firewall rule. Its helper requires an install path under Program Files, so this feature is unavailable from a standard Scoop app directory.
